constraints: If scope is omitted, the local execution context (the current process) is used.
If a local (ek local) error handler is also defined for a process, the global (ek global) handler is not called for that process.
If ON ERR CALL is called from a process running in preemptive mode (compiled), errorMethod must be thread-safe or the compiler raises an error.
ON ERR CALL cannot be called from within the error-handling method itself.
Error-handling methods are installed per project: components and host projects each have their own, and only the method of the project where the error occurred is called.

sentinelValues.meaning: Stops trapping errors for the given scope instead of installing a handler.

params.name: scope
params.description: Execution context for which errorMethod traps errors; a constant from the '4D Environment' theme.

sentinelValues.meaning: ek local: errors in the local execution context (current process); this is the default if scope is omitted.
ek global: errors in the global execution context of the project.
ek errors from components: errors generated from installed components.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Installs errorMethod as the error-catching method for the execution context designated by scope (local process, global, or components), or stops trapping errors for that scope if errorMethod is an empty string.
overloadMerges.note: Documented the errorMethod empty-string sentinel (stop trapping) and the scope constant sentinel values (ek local/ek global/ek errors from components), which autoparse left as bare Integer/Text.
